# Glide

> Glide is a voice-first AI assistant for the Mac that lives in the notch. Hold a key and talk: it answers questions about whatever is on your screen, points and draws on the screen to walk you through a task, runs background agents that do real work across your apps, and types free, on-device dictation into any app.

Platform: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. Mac only; there is no Windows, iPhone or Android version.
App languages: English, German, Spanish, Hindi, Swedish, Chinese and French. Glide answers in the language you speak to it.
Dictation: free and unlimited on every plan, and it runs entirely on your Mac, so the audio never leaves it. It understands 25 European languages.
Pricing: Free, then Pro at $20 a month and Ultra at $80 a month, or 20% less billed yearly ($16 and $64 a month). Prices in US dollars.
Free plan: 25 voice messages and 5 agent tasks every 20 days, no credit card.
Pro plan: 100 voice messages and 25 agent tasks a month. Ultra plan: 500 voice messages and 200 agent tasks a month.
Billing: Paddle is the merchant of record. You subscribe inside the Mac app, and every paid plan is refundable within 14 days.
Contact: hello@justglide.app

What Glide does:

- **Answers about your screen.** Glide looks at the document, email, page or error you have open when you ask, so you never have to explain the context.
- **Shows you how.** Ask how to do something and Glide highlights and labels the right place on your screen, one step at a time, checking each step before the next.
- **Runs agents in the background.** For a task, Glide starts an agent that works while you keep going and plays a chime when it is done. Agents connect to Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Notion, Linear, GitHub, Figma, HubSpot and LinkedIn, plus Mac apps like Mail, Notes, Calendar and Reminders.
- **Asks before acting outward.** Glide drafts emails and messages but never sends them without your approval, and anything destructive, like deleting files, needs your explicit yes.
- **Remembers on your Mac.** Glide keeps a text-only memory of what you worked on, stored on your Mac. It never saves screen images and never uses your data to train models, and Incognito pauses it.
- **Dictation.** Hold the fn key, speak, and clean, punctuated text lands in whatever app you are typing in.
